summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Qtrex Quantum Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing a notice of annual and extraordinary general meeting of shareholders. The filing includes standard proposals: reappointment of auditor, re-election of directors, approval of compensation policy, director fee increases, RSU grants, and an increase in authorized share capital. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, going-private transaction, or restructuring. The meeting is a normal governance procedure with no strategic catalyst or deal terms.
